verdict.rationale: Metorial provides hosted Magic MCP servers with standard MCP URLs that agents/MCP clients (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) can connect to, plus portals for discovery and connection, and remote MCP server linking — all documented and probe-confirmed live. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of an agent actually connecting via the MCP URL (community evidence covers auth clarity concerns but not a concrete connection failure), and clearer detail on protocol-level compliance testing.
